Edit collaborative text

Source: R/text.R
text.Rd

Positions and lengths count Unicode code points and are 1-based, matching substr().

  • text_insert() inserts value before the character currently at pos; pos = text_length(text) + 1 appends.

  • text_delete() removes len characters starting at pos.

  • text_splice() replaces len characters starting at pos with value, as a deletion followed by an insertion.

  • text_update() changes the text to value by computing a diff and applying only the insertions and deletions needed, so concurrent edits elsewhere in the text, marks, and cursors survive. With by = "line" the diff treats each line as a unit, which is faster for long texts but replaces a line whole when any part of it changes.

  • text_slice() returns len characters starting at pos.

  • text_get() returns the current contents as a string.

  • text_length() returns the number of characters, or the length in another unit.

  • text_convert_pos() converts a position between units, for exchanging positions with software that counts differently: JavaScript, and so browser-based editors, counts UTF-16 code units, in which a character outside the basic plane (most emoji) counts as two. Positions stay 1-based in every unit, so subtract 1 to get a 0-based JavaScript offset. A position in the middle of a character converts to the position of that character, and the result is NA if pos is out of range.

Usage

text_insert(text, pos, value)

text_delete(text, pos, len)

text_update(text, value, by = c("char", "line"))

text_splice(text, pos, len, value)

text_slice(text, pos, len)

text_get(text)

text_length(text, unit = c("unicode", "utf16", "utf8"))

text_convert_pos(
  text,
  pos,
  from = c("unicode", "utf16", "utf8"),
  to = c("utf16", "unicode", "utf8")
)

Arguments

text

A text handle, from doc_text() or a parent container.

pos

A 1-based character position.

value

A string: the text to insert, or the new contents for text_update().

len

Number of characters to delete, replace, or return.

by

Whether text_update() compares the old and new text character by character ("char") or line by line ("line").

unit, from, to

A unit for counting: "unicode" (code points, used everywhere else in this package), "utf16" (UTF-16 code units), or "utf8" (bytes).

Value

text_insert(), text_delete(), text_splice(), and text_update() return text invisibly, text_slice() a string, text_convert_pos() an integer, text_get() a string, and text_length() an integer.

Examples

doc = loro_doc()
text = doc_text(doc)
text_insert(text, 1, "Hello world")
text_delete(text, 1, 6)
text_get(text)
#> [1] "world"
text_length(text)
#> [1] 5

text_update(text, "brave new world")
text_get(text)
#> [1] "brave new world"
